articles.title: Nomura-backed Laser Digital wins Japan's first crypto approval in four years
articles.snippet: Laser Digital Japan will offer liquidity to domestic crypto providers, with institutional trading services planned to follow as the appetite for crypto in Japan grows.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC chief puts staff on notice to create crypto regulations if Clarity Act fails
articles.snippet: Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Mike Selig told the inaugural gathering of the Innovation Advisory Committee that his agency won't sit idle.

articles.title: Standard Chartered wavers on $100K Bitcoin year-end call, says it may be ‘too low’
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered’s Geoff Kendrick said Bitcoin could move toward its $126,000 all-time high after Oct. 6 as spot Bitcoin ETF inflows recover.

articles.title: Capital.com plans UAE spot crypto services after affiliate wins licence
articles.snippet: UAE clients will be able to buy and hold crypto through Capital.com’s app, expanding beyond price exposure through contracts for difference.

articles.title: CFTC chair says agency will move forward on crypto regulation if CLARITY fails
articles.snippet: Michael Selig said at a meeting of the Innovation Advisory Committee that he had directed CFTC staff to explore developer protections and other crypto-related policies.
